subject: Post-call recap: Meridian next steps — stakeholders, procurement path & systems scope
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <esoto@meridianhealth.org>, Tom Wallace <twallace@meridianhealth.org>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 30 Jan 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: Meridian next steps — stakeholders, procurement path & systems scope

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for a productive call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so nothing slips through the cracks: 

1) Stakeholders (as discussed)
   - Economic buyer: Elena Soto (Head of Data Strategy) — owns budget & timeline
   - Technical owner: Tom Wallace (Platform Lead) — will drive systems inventory and host/network details
   - Procurement / Legal: procurement@meridianhealth.org (procurement lead TBD)
   - Security reviewer: InfoSec team (please confirm contact)

2) Decision criteria you mentioned
   - Data isolation options (VPC/air-gapped preferred for PHI workloads)
   - Latency & SLA for inference (95th pct targets)
   - Audit trail / access logs and SOC2 evidence
   - Unit cost / quantization tradeoffs for model serving

3) Immediate asks from our side
   - Please confirm the primary security reviewer contact and procurement lead (email will suffice).
   - Share a simple systems-in-scope list: which Meridian systems will call the LLM (EHR integration, analytics, batch jobs, internal tools, etc.). A spreadsheet works.
   - We attached a short security questionnaire (Meridian_Security_Questionnaire_v2.xlsx). If you prefer, we can fill the first pass and mark fields for you to confirm.

4) Next steps / timeline
   - Security kickoff call: propose Wed 2/2 10:00–10:30 PT (we'll include our SRE and security SME).
   - Procurement intro: once procurement contact is shared, we’ll route commercial and standard enterprise terms.

If that reads correctly, I’ll schedule the kickoff and loop in Priyom (technical sales engineer) and Lauren (eng lead for pilot sizing).

Thanks — looking forward to progressing.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0198

Attachments: Meridian_Security_Questionnaire_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Date: Sun, 31 Jan 2027 09:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Meridian next steps — stakeholders, procurement path & systems scope

Ben —

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming the contacts on our side: 

- Economic buyer: Elena Soto (that's me)
- Technical owner: Tom Wallace (cc’d)
- Procurement: Priya Nambiar <priya.nambiar@meridianhealth.org> — procurement lead (I invited her into this thread)
- Security reviewer: Aaron Blake <aaron.blake@meridianhealth.org> (InfoSec)

Notes from our side: 
- Primary systems in scope for the pilot:
   • Patient intake portal (web)
   • Analytics pipeline (events → datalake) — uses Redshift and multiple ETL jobs
   • Internal triage tool (internal webapp that can surface patient-context snippets)

- Data sensitivity: pilot will include PHI-derived metadata in the triage tool; full PHI payloads will not be forwarded to third parties at pilot start.
- Timeline: procurement would like standard terms; target pilot kickoff week of 2/7. Security wants a short kickoff this week (2/2) to confirm boundaries and required artifacts.

I've reviewed the questionnaire and attached a quick internal note (see inline comments). We can either have Redwood fill the first pass or provide answers on our side — whichever saves cycles.

Elena
Head of Data Strategy — Meridian Health
esoto@meridianhealth.org

Attachments referenced: Meridian_internal_questions.docx (internal note for our InfoSec team)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <esoto@meridianhealth.org>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Tom Wallace <twallace@meridianhealth.org>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Feb 2027 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Meridian next steps — stakeholders, procurement path & systems scope

Thanks Elena — and hi all, Priyom here (technical SE on this deal). A few clarifying Qs to help scope the security kickoff: 

1) Systems boundary: when you say "analytics pipeline (events → datalake)", does Meridian host the model inputs (raw events) in the same VPC as Redshift, or are events forwarded to a separate ingest service? A one-line description helps map network flows.

2) Triage tool integration: will the triage tool call Redwood synchronously (per-request) or will you batch requests (e.g., nightly anonymized batches)? This affects prefix caching and latency SLOs.

3) Authentication & data flow: will calls to Redwood be made from an internal app server with mTLS + signed tokens, or via a third-party integration layer?

4) Required artifacts for security reviewers: to prepare, we can share: 
   - SOC2 summary & auditor contact
   - Network boundary template (redwood-network-boundary-template.pdf)
   - Data retention and purge policy excerpt

We can pre-fill the questionnaire with our default answers and mark items that need Meridian confirmation. If 2/2 at 10am PT works, I will have the network diagram and a filled-first-pass questionnaire ready.

Thanks — happy to jump on a short tech sync before the kickoff if you’d like.

—Priyom
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

From: Tom Wallace <twallace@meridianhealth.org>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Soto <esoto@meridianhealth.org>, Priya Nambiar <priya.nambiar@meridianhealth.org>, Aaron Blake <aaron.blake@meridianhealth.org>, Procurement Team <procurement@meridianhealth.org>
Date: Tue, 2 Feb 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Meridian next steps — stakeholders, procurement path & systems scope

On Mon, Feb 1, 2027 at 11:22 AM Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Elena — and hi all, Priyom here (technical SE on this deal). A few clarifying Qs to help scope the security kickoff:

Thanks, Priyom — that level of detail is exactly what we need. 10:00am PT on 2/2 works for a 30-minute kickoff; I’ll calendar that and invite Aaron and our network engineer, Mark Liu.

Quick answers inline: 
- Analytics pipeline: events land in an internal Kafka cluster in our private subnet; downstream ETL jobs write to Redshift. Calls into third-party services are made via a centralized egress gateway; no direct cross-VPC peering at present.
- Triage tool integration: initial pilot will be synchronous per-request from our internal webapp (low QPS expected), but we expect to evaluate an async batch path later.
- Auth: calls will originate from an internal app server using mTLS + signed tokens.

Requested artifacts for kickoff: 
- Your SOC2 summary and a bullet list of what logs are produced for access/usage
- A network boundary diagram (preferred PDF)
- Data retention / purge timings for model inputs/outputs

I’ll send a calendar invite for 2/2 10–10:30 PT and include Aaron, Priya, and Mark. Looking forward to it.

Tom Wallace
Platform Lead — Meridian Health
twallace@meridianhealth.org

Calendar: 2027-02-02 10:00–10:30 PT — Security Review Kickoff (Ben / Priyom / Aaron Blake / Mark Liu / Priya Nambiar)
